why: Searches for a resolution, disproof, or new case settled turned up only the known pre-2024 landscape (Hochster's equicharacteristic proof, Heitmann's dimension-3 mixed-characteristic proof, related work via almost Cohen-Macaulay algebras/André's mixed-characteristic techniques) plus adjacent 2024-2025 papers on local cohomology and homological conjectures in mixed characteristic that do not claim to resolve the remaining open mixed-characteristic dimension>3 cases of this specific conjecture.
